title: The AI Talent Britain Fought to Hire May Be Recalculating Its Future
summary: The article examines how proposed changes to UK immigration settlement rules would double the residency pathway from 5 to 10 years, affecting AI talent already working in Britain. This policy shift is creating an unexpected retention challenge for AI companies who fought to hire these skilled workers.
problem_solved: Highlights how policy changes are threatening to undermine years of effort to attract and retain international AI talent in the UK.
why_valuable: Reveals a critical intersection between immigration policy and AI industry talent retention that could impact Britain's competitive position in AI development.
